# World State, Memory & Spatial Context

> Scene graphs, semantic maps, spatial and episodic memory; the harness's context window onto the world.  
> Layer: L3 · 58 entries · [overview](../README.md#memory) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- ⚪ [**EvoMem-VLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05418 "EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation") · 2026-10 — VLA memory that encodes observed changes between historical states as directional delta tokens tied to their state evidence, so the policy can track interaction outcomes and task progress rather than isolated keyframes.
- ⚪ [**Divide-and-Remember**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00982 "Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies") · 2026-10 — Learned VLA memory that keeps history information relevant to the action but absent from the current observation, using a recursive top-K selector shared across blocks so a fixed-size module covers unbounded history; evaluated on RoboMME.
- ⚪ [**Workspace Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820 "Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision") · 2026-09 · MIT, CMU — Moves VLM calls to training time: a VLM labels task-salient current and past information, which is distilled into a lightweight latent 'workspace token' that policies use at deployment to solve memory-intensive tasks without in-the-loop VLM reasoning. _Note: CoRL 2026._
- ⚪ [**T2Mem**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36720 "T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics") · 2026-09 — Test-time-training memory inside a pretrained VLA: observation history is encoded into compact fast weights by online self-supervised updates and fed to the action expert, with no external reasoning model; evaluated on RoboMME.
- ⚪ [**SimpleARM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36595 "Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies") · 2026-09 · CMU; Tulane — Training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies: from the instruction it decides what to monitor, frozen perception tools keep compact typed state online, and that state is retrieved and re-grounded in the current view only when a subgoal depends on history; evaluated on RoboMME. _Note: Code repository says "Code will be released soon" (checked 2026-10-01)._ [project](https://simplearm.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**ME-Brain-1.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24271 "ME-Brain-1.0: Memory, Cognition and Action for Evolving Embodied Intelligence") · 2026-09 · MachEmbodied — Self-evolving embodied system built as a loop of execution, experience acquisition and evolution: an evolvable hierarchical memory of multimodal trajectories, a cognitive core that turns experience into skills, and an event-driven action model. _Note: Repository is a project page (report and videos); the MachEmbodied GitHub org also hosts Li Auto's ME-VLM._ [project](https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-Brain-1.0)
- ⚪ [**Ledger**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34554 "Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs") · 2026-09 · Harvard University — Harness that keeps short-term perceptual memory inside a fine-tuned pi0.5 policy and long-term object memory outside it, as a spatio-temporal object ledger built from a SAM3 tracker and VLM captions that an LLM planner reads at step boundaries. _Note: First-party: 64.3% four-suite average on RoboMME._
- ⚪ [**EvolvingNav**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39166 "Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds") · 2026-09 — Time-indexed 4D belief over objects that may move while unobserved, propagated by an event-driven filter with visibility-aware negative evidence, used by a frozen VLM controller to navigate; introduces EvoWorld-Bench (54 scenes).
- ⚪ [**ChronoGraph**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39665 "ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning") · 2026-09 — Functional 4D scene graph linking actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes, used for both explaining past interactions and planning future ones; comes with ChronoGraphBench and a ChronoGraphVLM trained with graph-as-chain-of-thought SFT and graph RL.
- ⚪ [**BeyondSCe**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39375 "Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection") · 2026-09 — Zero-shot grasping system for requests that refer to an object's role in a previously observed human interaction; combines an event prior from the history with current geometry to choose camera views that reveal occluded targets, using only pretrained models. _Note: Official repository (SNU-VGILab/BeyondCSe) says code is coming soon (checked 2026-10-05)._ [project](https://www.haebeom.com/BeyondCSe/)
- 🟡 [**PonderPounce**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24115 "PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control") · 2026-08 · MAUM.AI, Seoul National University, Georgia Tech — Uses a pretrained System-2 MLLM's native context as episode memory: it folds execution history and demonstrations into continuously refreshed 'cognition' that an asynchronous System-1 action model conditions on; evaluated on RoboMME. [project](https://worv-ai.github.io/ponderpounce/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/worv-ai/ponderpounce-9b-robomme)
- ⚪ [**Mimir**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04933 "Mimir: A Neuro-Symbolic Memory System with Dynamic Grounding for Embodied Agents in Interactive Environments") · 2026-08 — Neuro-symbolic memory that separates world memory (object locations, states, evidence) from task memory (goal agenda, progress, failures) and grounds the active goal before each action; evaluated on EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat.
- ⚪ [**Worth Remembering**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03787 "Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory") · 2026-06 · MIT, Lockheed Martin — Decides which episodes a robot should store by gating memory formation with Bayesian surprise computed in V-JEPA 2's latent space, augmenting a 4D scene-graph spatial memory for robot question answering.
- 🟢 [**RAVEN**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25206 "RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory") · 2026-06 · Princeton University, University of Pennsylvania — Agentic memory that stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer long-horizon questions and navigate to goals, avoiding lossy captioning; demonstrated on a Unitree Go1. [code](https://github.com/princeton-prism/RAVEN) · [project](https://ravenmem.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**HALO**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25136 "Memory Retrieval in Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Robot Control") · 2026-06 · UT Austin — Visuomotor policy with attention-based memory retrieval over up to eight minutes of history; distills VLM priors through memory-dependent video QA to avoid spurious correlations and uses sparse attention to limit compounding memory errors. [project](https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO)
- 🟢 [**FARM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15476 "FARM: Find Anything using Relational Spatial Memory") · 2026-06 · UC Berkeley, Stanford University — Real-time (5-10 Hz) open-vocabulary object-level memory with geometry, visual-language descriptors and viewpoint evidence; queries are parsed by VLMs and spatial relations grounded through object symbols and predicates to find specific instances. _Note: Deployed closed-loop on a quadruped with onboard compute (first-party)._ [code](https://github.com/GoldenGait/FARM-Project) · [project](https://goldengait.github.io/farm/)
- ⚪ [**H2-EMV**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11306 "Learning to Forget -- Hierarchical Episodic Memory for Lifelong Robot Deployment") · 2026-04 · Karlsruhe Institute of Technology — Hierarchical episodic memory that lets a humanoid verbalize past experience and learn what to forget, using LLM-based relevance estimation conditioned on natural-language rules refined from user feedback; evaluated on 20.5 h of ARMAR-7 recordings. _Note: First-party: about 45% smaller memory at maintained QA accuracy._
- 🟢 [**RoboStream**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12939 "RoboStream: Weaving Spatio-Temporal Reasoning with Memory in Vision-Language Models for Robotics") · 2026-03 · Tsinghua University (SIGS), et al. — Training-free memory layer for VLM planners: spatio-temporal fusion tokens bind visual evidence to 3D attributes for persistent object grounding, and a causal spatio-temporal graph records action-triggered state transitions across long-horizon manipulation. _Note: ECCV 2026._ [code](https://github.com/yu2hi13/RoboStream) · [project](https://robostream123.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**MEM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03596 "MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models") · 2026-03 · Physical Intelligence — Mixed-modal memory for VLA policies that pairs video-based short-horizon memory (compressed by a video encoder) with text-based long-horizon memory, letting robot policies carry out multi-stage tasks lasting up to about fifteen minutes. _Note: The arXiv entry points to a Physical Intelligence research page; that page rate-limited automated access, so only the paper is linked._
- 🟢 [**GSMem**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19137 "GSMem: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Persistent Spatial Memory for Zero-Shot Embodied Exploration and Reasoning") · 2026-03 · Case Western Reserve University, University at Buffalo — Uses 3D Gaussian Splatting as persistent spatial memory so an exploring agent can re-render optimal novel views of remembered regions for VLM reasoning, localizing targets via parallel object-level scene graphs and language fields. [code](https://github.com/vulab-AI/GSMem) · [project](https://vulab-ai.github.io/GSMem/)
- 🟢 [**STaR**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09255 "STaR: Scalable Task-Conditioned Retrieval for Long-Horizon Multimodal Robot Memory") · 2026-02 · University of Toronto, York University — Agentic framework that builds a task-agnostic multimodal long-term memory (object attributes, spatial relations, dynamic events) and extracts compact task-relevant context with an Information-Bottleneck-based retrieval algorithm for reasoning and navigation. _Note: RA-L 2026 (per repository README)._ [code](https://github.com/TRAILab/STaR) · [project](https://trailab.github.io/STaR-website/)
- 🟢 [**PhysMem**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20323 "PhysMem: Scaling Test-Time Memory for Embodied Physical Reasoning") · 2026-02 · UC San Diego, Stanford University — Test-time memory for VLM robot planners that records interaction experience, forms hypotheses about physical properties and verifies them through targeted interaction before promoting them to guide later decisions, without updating model weights. [code](https://github.com/haoyangli16/PhysMem) · [project](https://phys-mem.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**MemCtrl**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20831 "MemCtrl: Using MLLMs as Active Memory Controllers on Embodied Agents") · 2026-01 · University of Maryland — Adds a trainable memory head to an MLLM that decides online which observations or reflections to retain, update or discard during exploration, trained from an offline expert or with online RL, instead of treating memory as offline RAG storage.

- 🟢 [**M3**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.16413 "M3: 3D-Spatial MultiModal Memory") · 2025-03 · UC San Diego, NVIDIA — Multimodal scene memory that stores foundation-model features in 3D Gaussian Splatting, using principal scene components and Gaussian memory attention to compress high-dimensional features; deployed as a feature field on a quadruped robot indoors. _Note: ICLR 2025._ [code](https://github.com/MaureenZOU/m3-spatial) · [project](https://m3-spatial-memory.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**Mem2Ego**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14254 "Mem2Ego: Empowering Vision-Language Models with Global-to-Ego Memory for Long-Horizon Embodied Navigation") · 2025-02 · Huawei Noah's Ark Lab — VLM navigation framework that adaptively retrieves task-relevant cues from a global memory module and aligns them with the agent's egocentric observations, rather than verbalizing maps into text, for long-horizon object navigation.

- 🟢 [**VLMaps**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.05714 "Visual Language Maps for Robot Navigation") · 2022-10 · University of Freiburg, Google — Fuses pretrained visual-language features into a 3D reconstruction to build a spatial map that can be indexed with natural language; combined with an LLM, instructions become open-vocabulary, spatially precise navigation goals. _Note: ICRA 2023._ [code](https://github.com/vlmaps/vlmaps) · [project](https://vlmaps.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**CLIP-Fields**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.05663 "CLIP-Fields: Weakly Supervised Semantic Fields for Robotic Memory") · 2022-10 · NYU, Meta AI — Implicit scene model that maps 3D locations to semantic embeddings, trained only with supervision from web-trained models (CLIP, Detic, Sentence-BERT) and used as a queryable scene memory for real-world semantic navigation. _Note: RSS 2023._ [code](https://github.com/notmahi/clip-fields) · [project](https://mahis.life/clip-fields/)
- ⚪ [**NLMap**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09874 "Open-vocabulary Queryable Scene Representations for Real World Planning") · 2022-09 · Robotics at Google — Builds a natural-language-queryable scene representation with VLMs; an LLM proposes the objects an instruction needs, queries the map for their availability and location, and plans with that context (paired with SayCan on real robots). _Note: No official code; the project page links a third-party reimplementation._ [project](https://nlmap-saycan.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**Hydra**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.13360 "Hydra: A Real-time Spatial Perception System for 3D Scene Graph Construction and Optimization") · 2022-01 · MIT SPARK Lab — Real-time spatial perception system that incrementally builds and optimizes a layered 3D scene graph (objects, places, rooms) from sensor data as the robot explores, giving it a hierarchical metric-semantic model of the environment. _Note: RSS 2022; extended in 'Foundations of Spatial Perception for Robotics' (arXiv 2305.07154, submitted to IJRR)._ [code](https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/Hydra)
